name: my captain's unbinding
source:
The newest chapter of Infinity Sailor, the year's hottest shonen manga, has caused a major uproar. Fan favorite deuteragonist Captain Jack Graye is secretly...  a woman! Fans of the BL ship Sigraye are in shambles, and the discourse is impossible to escape. Longtime reader Sarah Wilson thought she was above it all-- until, inexplicably, she came home and found Graye alive and animated in her bedroom.

Bad enough to start hallucinating, but for such a stupid reason? Why is this happening? How can Sarah make this go away? And why does Graye keep looking at her like that?

[From [url=https://ruemilley.itch.io/my-captains-unbinding]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今年最火的少年漫画《无限水手》的最新章节引起了轩然大波。粉丝们最喜欢的副主角杰克·格雷船长其实是……一个女人！BL舰Sigraye的粉丝们一片狼藉，言论无处可逃。长期读者莎拉·威尔逊认为她高于一切——直到她莫名其妙地回到家，发现格雷伊在她的卧室里还活着，充满活力。

糟糕到已经开始产生幻觉了，但为了这么愚蠢的理由？为什么会发生这种情况？莎拉怎样才能让这件事消失呢？为什么格雷一直这样看着她？

[来自[url=https://ruemilley.itch.io/my-captains-unbinding]itch.io[/url]]
